answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can gate reward standing behind a staked trust-bridge: to cross into eligibility, an identity needs several established non-kin peers to lock scarce collateral endorsing it, then keep lighting a signed liveness beacon each epoch. That bridge is framed from real timber: bonds that burn if a jury proves the crosser fake, so vouching costs honest peers finite capital. Fielding N clones demands N separately funded crossings, each with its own slashable stake and beacon, so attacker cost scales linearly at N times collateral; a beacon-less identity never crosses.
